album.title: The Mirza Abdollah Radif for Tar and Setar, Vol. 4

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on F4 and dwells most on Ak in Shahkhatayi. The line peaks at Eb5 (591.2 Hz) at 0:28.1. It closes on G3, not the tonic (Ak4 → Ak4 → Ak4 → G4 → G4 → G3).
